purpose: Route and lifecycle classification only. This register does not restate theorem language, artifact hashes, DOI values, or result statuses; it points to records that own those facts.
coverage: Only explicitly classified current work. Filenames and historical draft wording do not infer an area assignment.

areas.label: Locked record
areas.reading_rule: A public result with its named source, carrier, condition, and applicable check or pin.

areas.label: Development
areas.reading_rule: Readable draft or held work with an explicit admission condition; excluded from sitemap and LLM/result discovery until released.

areas.label: Archive
areas.reading_rule: Retained historical bytes, not a current result claim.

records.admission_condition: Independently checked source package, explicit release/pin record, and separate promotion decision.
